headword: {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}

definitions.explanation: The offense of parking a vehicle in a prohibited area or exceeding the permitted parking time. A very common traffic violation in Japan.

examples.japanese: {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}られた→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I got a ticket for a parking violation.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{止|と}めたら→止める：00678_tomeru⟧{駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you park here, it'll be a parking violation.

examples.japanese: {都心部|としんぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{締|し}まり→取り締まり：07445_torishimari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Enforcement of parking violations has become stricter in the city center.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}→駐車：01466_chuusha⟧ (parking) + ⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧ (violation). One of the most common traffic violations in Japan. Since 2006, private parking enforcement officers ({駐車監視員|ちゅうしゃかんしいん}) patrol many urban areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}られる→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to get a parking ticket
- {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{締|し}まり→取り締まり：07445_torishimari⟧: enforcement of parking violations
- {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反則金|はんそくきん}: parking violation fine
- {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}⟦シール→シール：09597_shiiru⟧: parking violation sticker (placed on windshield)

- ⟦{路上駐車|ろじょうちゅうしゃ}→路上駐車：24063_rojouchuusha⟧: on-street parking
- ⟦{違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}→違法駐車：22923_ihouchuusha⟧: illegal parking (synonym)
- ⟦{駐車禁止|ちゅうしゃきんし}→駐車禁止：09691_chuushakinshi⟧: no parking
